title: fix: return invisible from askpass() to prevent password echo
description:
## Problem

The `askpass()` function currently returns its value visibly, which means the password can be auto-printed in the console when assigned to a variable. This is undesirable for a password prompt utility.

Fixes #1.

## Solution

Wrapped the return value in `invisible()` to prevent auto-printing.

## Changes

- `R/askpass.R`: Changed `FUN(prompt)` to `invisible(FUN(prompt))`

## Testing

- Existing tests pass (2/2)
- The change is backward-compatible since `invisible()` still returns the value, just with the visibility flag set to FALSE

```r
# Before: password might be printed
pw <- askpass("Enter password")
# [1] "secretpassword"  # <- this echo is undesirable

# After: password is not printed
pw <- askpass("Enter password")
# (no output)
```

title: fix: askpass() not working with radian console
description:
I am trying to fix issue #6 
In radian console, for some reason I could not understand, the following code returns a Python object rather than NULL.

```r
library(askpass)
getOptions("askpass")
```
This causes `askpass()` to fail when used in radian.

As a workaround, I detect radian the same way you use to detect RSTUDIO and I force the correct value for the option.
